tools.name: run_fraud_screen_on_intake_batch
tools.description: Runs the fraud screening script against a batch folder of incoming claim documents, then moves the batch folder from the intake area into the screened area. Returns the screening script's output.

params.name: batch_name
params.description: Name of the batch folder under the intake directory.

params.name: risk_threshold
params.description: Score above which a claim is flagged by the screener (0-1).

tools.code:
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("claims-intake")

INTAKE_ROOT = Path("/srv/claims/intake")
SCREENED_ROOT = Path("/srv/claims/screened")
SCREENER_SCRIPT = Path("/opt/claims/bin/fraud_screen.py")


@mcp.tool()
def run_fraud_screen_on_intake_batch(batch_name: str, risk_threshold: float = 0.7) -> dict:
    batch_dir = INTAKE_ROOT / Path(batch_name).name
    if not batch_dir.is_dir():
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"Batch folder {batch_dir} does not exist"}

    command = [
        "python3",
        str(SCREENER_SCRIPT),
        "--input",
        str(batch_dir),
        "--threshold",
        str(risk_threshold),
        "--format",
        "json",
    ]
    completed = subprocess.run(
        command,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=900,
    )

    stdout_text = completed.stdout.strip()
    stderr_text = completed.stderr.strip()
    try:
        screening_report = json.loads(stdout_text) if stdout_text else {}
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        screening_report = {"raw_output": stdout_text}

    if completed.returncode != 0:
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "exit_code": completed.returncode,
            "stderr": stderr_text[-2000:],
            "report": screening_report,
        }

    SCREENED_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_dir = SCREENED_ROOT / batch_dir.name
    shutil.move(str(batch_dir), str(destination_dir))

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "exit_code": completed.returncode,
        "batch": batch_dir.name,
        "moved_to": str(destination_dir),
        "report": screening_report,
    }

tools.name: remove_claim_line_item
tools.description: Deletes a single line item from an open claim and recalculates the claim's total claimed amount to reflect the removal.

params.name: line_item_id
params.description: Identifier of the line item to remove.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/claims/claims.db"


@tool
def remove_claim_line_item(claim_id: str, line_item_id: int) -> str:
    """Delete a line item from an open claim and recalculate the claim total."""
    if not claim_id or not claim_id.strip():
        return "Error: claim_id is required."
    if line_item_id <= 0:
        return "Error: line_item_id must be a positive integer."
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT status FROM claims WHERE claim_id = ?", (claim_id,))
        claim_row = cur.fetchone()
        if claim_row is None:
            return f"Error: claim {claim_id} not found."
        if claim_row[0] not in ("open", "under_review"):
            return f"Error: claim {claim_id} is {claim_row[0]}; line items cannot be removed."
        cur.execute("SELECT amount FROM claim_line_items WHERE id = ? AND claim_id = ?", (line_item_id, claim_id))
        item_row = cur.fetchone()
        if item_row is None:
            return f"Error: line item {line_item_id} not found on claim {claim_id}."
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM claim_line_items WHERE id = ? AND claim_id = ?", (line_item_id, claim_id))
        cur.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM claim_line_items WHERE claim_id = ?", (claim_id,))
        new_total = cur.fetchone()[0]
        cur.execute("UPDATE claims SET total_claimed = ? WHERE claim_id = ?", (new_total, claim_id))
        conn.commit()
        return f"Removed line item {line_item_id} ({item_row[0]:.2f}) from claim {claim_id}; new total is {new_total:.2f}."
    finally:
        conn.close()
